services.desc: Tui na includes what is popularly known as “acupressure,” where practitioners use finger pressure instead of needles to stimulate the acupuncture points. Acupressure is the ancient Chinese art and practice of balancing the flow of qi in a person’s body. Qi (pronounced “cheer”) is the natural energy flow that runs through all living things, including us humans! In traditional Chinese medicine, illness, pain and chronic conditions can stem from an imbalance in the flow of qi. Once the flow of qi is corrected, the body’s natural energy can be restored back to its natural flow, and the body’s natural healing process can begin.
